summary: Automations: «My tasks» inbox at /automations/tasks — human-node tasks assigned to the user, their roles, groups or permissions or delegated to them (tasks.TaskInbox over the human tasks substrate, visible to the current audience only), decided with the node's outcome buttons, comment and typed schema fields, delegated to a colleague, with overdue and decided-by-me tabs and a navigation counter (application.NavNode.Badge); HUMAN_REQUIRED (403 with code) for agents. TaskForm extension point (tasks.ContributeTaskForm, `x-iota-form` annotation validated on save, never run past the final deadline); the module registers the human node, its task bridge and observer, the native entity automation.task and event automation.task.assigned.v1 (automations.Natives) and its notification to the assignees, checked at delivery by the rule of automation.task (notifications.ContributeSubjectAccess). Record names for subjects (pkg/automation/subjects; core.user and crm.client contributed). workflow.Engine.TasksByID and Task.PastFinalDeadline. Route auth policies honor the pattern of a route variable ({id:<regex>}), so a literal sibling route keeps its own policy.
